# Week 3: Services, DI, state and routing

**Goal:** Share state through services, understand injector scopes, and structure an app with lazy routes.

About 8 hours. Do the steps in order; skip steps marked for the other track.

## 1. Read: [Dependency injection guide](https://angular.dev/guide/di)

- [ ] Done · Both tracks · about 60 min
- Concepts: Dependency injection

## 2. Read: [Routing guide: routes, lazy loading, child routes, input binding](https://angular.dev/guide/routing)

- [ ] Done · Both tracks · about 60 min
- Concepts: Routing and lazy loading

## 3. Watch: [Angular – The Complete Guide (Udemy): services, DI and routing sections](https://www.udemy.com/course/the-complete-guide-to-angular-2/)

- [ ] Done · Both tracks · about 150 min
- No course licence? Watch the matching topics on the official Angular YouTube channel instead.
- Concepts: Dependency injection, Routing and lazy loading

## 4. Explore in the app: Concepts Lab: Dependency injection

- [ ] Done · Both tracks · about 45 min
- Open in the running app: `http://localhost:4200/lab/di`
- Files: [`src/app/features/concepts-lab/di-demo.ts`](../../src/app/features/concepts-lab/di-demo.ts), [`src/app/features/concepts-lab/counter-store.ts`](../../src/app/features/concepts-lab/counter-store.ts)
- Look for: Two panels, two LocalCounter ids, one SharedCounter id; InjectionToken factories; the ReportExporter chunk appearing in the Network tab only on click (injectAsync).
- Concepts: Dependency injection

## 5. Study the code: The cart signal store

- [ ] Done · Both tracks · about 40 min
- Open in the running app: `http://localhost:4200/cart`
- Files: [`src/app/core/services/cart.store.ts`](../../src/app/core/services/cart.store.ts), [`src/app/features/cart/cart.ts`](../../src/app/features/cart/cart.ts)
- Look for: Private writable signal, public readonly view, immutable updates, computed totals, effect() persisting to storage.
- Concepts: Signal-based state stores, Signals: signal, computed, effect, linkedSignal, resource

## 6. Study the code: Routes and lazy loading

- [ ] Done · Both tracks · about 40 min
- Files: [`src/app/app.routes.ts`](../../src/app/app.routes.ts), [`src/app/features/concepts-lab/lab.routes.ts`](../../src/app/features/concepts-lab/lab.routes.ts), [`src/app/features/concepts-lab/lab-layout.ts`](../../src/app/features/concepts-lab/lab-layout.ts)
- Look for: loadComponent with default exports, loadChildren, nested <router-outlet>, routerLinkActive, titles as translation keys.
- Concepts: Routing and lazy loading
